Android requires this access so SevenMirror can detect notification changes and available actions.

Grant access only if you trust this app and your SevenMirror deployment. App selection in the next step controls your saved sharing preference. If access is removed later, SevenMirror clears its mirrored active set until access returns.

Ready to synchronize selected app notifications

Only notifications from selected apps leave this device. Their content is end-to-end encrypted for authorized recipient devices.
Devices authorized to use this SevenMirror workspace.

Approve, reject, or remove devices in the server admin page.
To change servers, first remove this device in the current server admin page, then reinstall SevenMirror and join the new server.
Your app selection stays on this Android device. Notification content is end-to-end encrypted for authorized recipient devices, so the relay server cannot read it.
If this device loses access or its saved setup cannot be used, ask the server administrator to remove the old device. Then reinstall SevenMirror and join with a new one-time code.
SevenMirror cannot continue using the access information saved on this device.
Ask the server administrator to remove this device from the workspace, then reopen SevenMirror.
The server administrator removed this device. Register it again and obtain approval to continue using SevenMirror.

SevenMirror will remove the workspace access information saved on this device. Your application selection and remote operation settings will remain. You will need a new joining code and administrator approval.
